name: confirm
title: Confirm Drawer
description: A destructive-action confirmation drawer built on scrollsheet's Drawer. dismissible={false} and disableDrag block swipe, backdrop tap, and Esc, so only its own two buttons can close it.
author: Ansuman Shah <https://github.com/ansumanshah>

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Drawer, DrawerClose, DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerTitle, DrawerTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/drawer" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" interface ConfirmDrawerProps { trigger: React.ReactNode title: string description: string confirmLabel?: string cancelLabel?: string onConfirm: () => void destructive?: boolean } /** * A bottom sheet that only closes through its own buttons. * `dismissible={false}` blocks swipe, backdrop tap, and Esc; `disableDrag` * removes the drag gesture entirely. Use where an accidental swipe must * never confirm the action. */ function ConfirmDrawer({ trigger, title, description, confirmLabel = "Confirm", cancelLabel = "Cancel", onConfirm, destructive = true, }: ConfirmDrawerProps) { const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false) return ( {trigger} {title} {description}
{cancelLabel}
) } export { ConfirmDrawer, type ConfirmDrawerProps }
